coach: rewritten midday - wind, ankle, and a correction
headline: Gusts hit 87 km/h by this evening, so the brick moves to tomorrow 07:00 - and you have run off the bike before, my mistake.
body:
Correction first: **you completed the 29 August brick run.** The watch died before it, so there is no file, but the run happened. Tomorrow is the measurement, not the first attempt.

The wind is worse than it feels: **gusts 71 km/h by midday, 87 by 19:00**, south-easter all day. Tomorrow morning is **8-10 km/h, gusts under 33**, 14-21 degrees. Roll out at 07:00 - by 15:00 it is 28.

Today: **1,800 m pool** - 400 warm-up, 6 x 150 off 20 s, 400 easy - plus the ankle block, **both sides**. Zero ankle load, legs fresh.

Tomorrow: **85 km at 140-150 bpm**, 155 cap on the climbs, then **20 min off the bike** at 6:45-7:00/km. Twenty is enough to capture the split you have never had a file for; the extra fifteen only load the ankle.

This morning: **HRV 64 against a 14-day mean of 60**, first above baseline since 31 August. Only the wind changed today.

Physio Monday.
